dev_dependencies.name: knip
dev_dependencies.reason: dead_code gate: unused files, exports and dependencies. The registry is checked (deprecation, engines) before installation; the exclusions in knip.json are scaffold calibration, not policy.

dev_dependencies.name: @axe-core/playwright
dev_dependencies.reason: accessibility gate: axe analysis inside the Playwright suite. The registry is checked (deprecation, engines) before installation.

setup.notes: scan:secrets requires a gitleaks binary on PATH; its built-in rule set was measured inert on 2026-09-10, so .gitleaks.toml carries explicit rules. playwright.config.ts gains a testMatch that covers both *.e2e.ts (the a11y spec) and the scaffold's own *.test.ts demo; the manual installation of 2026-09-10 matched only *.e2e.ts and silently dropped the demo test.
